title.narrative: Deliver assistance for the prevention and treatment of malnutrition in children and Pregnant and Lactating Women and Girls (PLWGs).

description.narrative: CERF funding supports WFP’s delivery of moderate acute malnutrition (MAM) treatment and prevention assistance to children and pregnant and lactating women and girls (PLGW) in line with the Strategic Objective of the CERF allocation to alleviate the suffering of the highly food insecure population in Yemen. This will be accomplished through the procurement, dispatch, and distribution of specialized nutrition commodities through communities and district health centres. This project targets 88,322 affected people with its Nutrition engagement.
